Market today: Tech is getting hammered again, led by Nvidia. AI hype is fading, and investors are spooked by inflation and rising rates, pushing them to safer assets. This is hitting your concentrated tech/chip book hard, especially with leverage.

Your holdings: Most of your positions are marked 'SELL' and are deep in the red. CRWD is up 17.27%, but QQQ, SMH, SMCI, SNOW, and all your leveraged ETFs (PLTU, MSFU, MU, SOXL, SPAL, METU) are down significantly. QQQI is also down. SPY is only slightly down. Your stops are mostly far away, especially on the leveraged names.

Watch: Nvidia's continued weakness and the broader tech sell-off. Also, keep an eye on the 10-year Treasury yield.

Bottom line: Your leveraged tech bets are bleeding, and the market mood is sour. Focus on managing risk and protecting capital.
plays: Consider trimming QQQ/QQQI if they break key support levels.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
